source.description: Approved handmade raster 3x2 felt-tip-marker process contact sheet, cropped only after full-sheet review.
source.notes: One friendly face-free rocket planter with a single sprout; no lettering or embedded UI.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels preserve one upright rocket planter: scaffold, rocket shell, fins and window, sprout, ink, then only bright marker fill and small highlights.

final_elements.name: rocket planter shell
final_elements.description: One upright rounded rocket with nose cone, open top rim, and three lower fins.

final_elements.name: three lower fins
final_elements.description: Exactly three rounded lower fins attached to the rocket shell.

final_elements.name: round window
final_elements.description: One circular blue window centered on the shell.

final_elements.name: sprout
final_elements.description: One curved stem with exactly two leaves emerging from the open top.

final_elements.name: two-leaf sprout contour
final_elements.description: The refined curved stem and exactly two leaves above the rim.

final_elements.name: marker color and shadow
final_elements.description: Red shell, teal window, green sprout, yellow fins, white shine marks, and a broken navy shadow.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Rocket rim leaves the stem route open so the sprout reads as growing from inside.
Shell and ground-shadow lines stop at the three planned fin footprints.

frames.visible_job: Place one tall rocket oval, nose cone, open rim, three fin guides, window circle, one sprout stem with two leaf routes, shine gaps, and broken shadow reserve.
Connect the established shell, nose cone, open top rim, and three fin silhouettes while keeping sprout and window reserves open.
Draw the one reserved round window and its simple inner ring.
Draw the established curved stem and exactly two leaves emerging above the rim.
Trace only the established shell, three fins, window, stem, two leaves, shine gaps, and broken shadow with thick imperfect black marker.

final_step.visible_job: Only fill established shapes with marker color, preserve shine gaps, and clarify existing contours and shadow.

rejection_checks: Reject any panel that changes the rocket silhouette, three-fin count, window, stem, or two-leaf count.
Reject a final that introduces a new prop, flame, face, lettering, or color region absent in an earlier panel.
Reject clean vector-like marks, poster finish, or a non-cumulative redraw.
